item.title: Spartans earn four podiums at 3A State Tournament

item.title: San Rafael Middle School Student of the Week
item.description: Wyatt Barton Wyatt is the son of Angie and Greg Barton of Castle Dale. He participates in football and wrestling. He was the SRMS wrestling captain. His favorite class is shop. He enjoys hunting, fishing, dirt bikes, riding horses, and trapping. In the future, he wants to go to trade school and be a welder.
